title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - LostPackets
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/LostPackets. Percentage of lost packets compared to the total number of exchanged packets. Subclass of QuantityKind per the Gaia-X ontology; the source ontology fixes applicableUnit to https://qudt.org/vocab/unit/PERCENT for this subtype via a validation rule.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LostPackets'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

applicableUnit.description: Property. Unit of the quantity value, fixed to PERCENT for LostPackets per the source ontology's validation rule.
